note: The THIRD fresh held-out set (168), written for the reader that ships after the m11/query-split review fixes. Distinct from labels.json (62), fresh-labels.json (80) and fresh2-labels.json (160): no question repeats any of them, word for word or with the punctuation taken out (checked when written). Written and committed before any run on it; nothing was tuned on it. What is new about this set is the second model: the earlier sets scored two RAW models, and this one scores one raw model (northstar, no descriptions and no synonyms) and one prepared for AI (contoso-ai: the same Contoso-style model with a description on every table, column and measure, and the words a person would use for each). The reader that ships reads all three, so a set of raw models alone would not score what it does. Same conventions as fresh2-labels.json: each measures and groupBy entry is one slot listing every right reading; a filter is right when its column is one of those listed, its op matches, and its values are the same set; order is not scored; decline means nothing should be settled; refused means the right reading exists and the reach check must refuse it. Placeholder names only: Northstar is the UAT fixture, Contoso is built in JevQueryReplay.cs.
